column7: The core-side global-admin holder count (ListProjectRoleAssignments(ctx, 0)) filtered project_id only, so an admin grant at {ProjectID: 0, EnvironmentID: X}, which applies only inside environment X, counted as a surviving global admin and the install's only real global admin could be suspended. The shape is creatable via POST /api/v1/user-roles (server/http TestAssignRoleHTTP_EnvironmentScopedGlobalProjectGrantIsCreatable). Fixed: the global listing also requires environment_id = 0, agreeing with ListGlobalAdminAssignmentsForUpdate. Red on main.
